proposals.text:
Thanks — and thanks for providing your DOB and phone number.

I can’t look up accounts by phone number with the tools I have available. To proceed with the account-level investigation I need one of the lookup identifiers you were given earlier: either

- your full name (case-sensitive as it appears on the account), OR  
- your Rho‑Bank user ID, OR  
- the email address on file.

I already have two verification values (DOB and phone number), which is exactly what I’ll need once you give one of those lookup identifiers. Pick whichever lookup method you prefer and share it here (if you choose full name, please copy it exactly as on the account to avoid case mismatch).

If you don’t want to share any of those here, you can instead:
- Call 1-800-RHO-BANK and ask to open a rewards investigation, or
- Use secure chat in the Rho‑Bank mobile app to complete verification and request the investigation.

Tell me which lookup identifier you’ll provide (or which alternate channel you prefer) and I’ll proceed.
